title: Goji v0.2.27 Available
message:
A new version of Goji has arrived with key quality-of-life updates:
• Live Player HUD: Battery percentage and charging status now refresh in real-time during playback.
• Episode Release Alarms: Background push notifications now schedule automatically so you never miss an episode.
• In-App Manga Alerts: Notifies you the moment new chapters drop while browsing or watching.
• In-App APK Downloader: Download and install new updates directly within Goji with live progress tracking.
